name: Morphing menu
description: A small surface becomes the next step.
detail: A trigger and its options share one visual surface. Keep the menu close to the action it supports.
when: A compact action trigger opening a nearby set of commands.
integration: Supply actions with onSelect callbacks and a label. Preserve menu focus and keyboard behavior. In an existing Radix menu, adapt the surface motion instead of replacing the primitive.
props: actions, label, speed, radius, className, style
